templates.name: Subscription_Email_Confirmation
templates.subject: Please confirm your email
templates.body:
Hi,

Please confirm you'd like to receive emails from the Executive Capacity Map:

Confirm my subscription

If you didn't request this, ignore this email and nothing will happen.

Charlie
Executive Capacity Map

templates.name: Subscription_Confirmation
templates.subject: You're subscribed
templates.body:
Hi,

You're confirmed. Your first email from the Executive Capacity Map is on its way: short, practical, and focused on fitting plans to the capacity you actually have.

Charlie
Executive Capacity Map

{% if unsubscribe_url %}

Unsubscribe

{% endif %}

templates.name: Welcome 1 - Your capacity checklist
templates.subject: Your capacity checklist (and how to use it)
templates.body:
Hi {{ FirstName | default: 'there' }},

Thanks for confirming. Here's the short version of how the Executive Capacity Map works: we look at the pattern before we make the plan.

Over the next week I'll send a few short notes on what that means for focus, energy and follow-through in midlife, and why the usual productivity advice often misses the real constraint.

Charlie

{% if unsubscribe_url %}

Unsubscribe

{% endif %}

templates.name: Welcome 2 - The pattern before the plan
templates.subject: The pattern before the plan
templates.body:
Hi {{ FirstName | default: 'there' }},

Most plans fail for a predictable reason: they're built for the capacity you had, not the capacity you have this season.

The Executive Capacity Map separates longstanding patterns from what's changing now (sleep, load, context) so the plan fits the person, not the other way around.

Charlie

{% if unsubscribe_url %}

Unsubscribe

{% endif %}

templates.name: Welcome 3 - How the Partnership works
templates.subject: What a capacity-adjusted plan looks like
templates.body:
Hi {{ FirstName | default: 'there' }},

In the Midlife Capacity Partnership we map your capacity, set commitments that flex with it, and keep weekly accountability so the plan survives real life.

It's coaching, not medical or mental health care, and it works alongside any care you already have.

Charlie

{% if unsubscribe_url %}

Unsubscribe

{% endif %}

templates.name: Welcome 4 - Fit call invitation
templates.subject: Want to see if it's a fit?
templates.body:
Hi {{ FirstName | default: 'there' }},

If any of this sounded familiar, the next step is a 15-minute fit call. No pitch deck: we look at whether a capacity-first approach makes sense for you right now.

Just reply to this email and I'll send times.

Charlie

{% if unsubscribe_url %}

Unsubscribe

{% endif %}
